# New Service Template - Placeholder App

This is a simple placeholder Go application that allows `make build` to work in the new-service-template directory.

**This is NOT the actual service code that gets generated by cookiecutter.**

When you run `cookiecutter new-service-template`, the actual service code will be generated from:
- `{{cookiecutter.app_name}}/cmd/main.go` - The template for the generated service's main.go

This placeholder app is only here to make the template directory buildable for development and testing purposes.
